worker_initial.scope:
Bounded CPU observations at pinned vLLM encoder dispatch boundaries.

Install after model startup through the official worker extension/RPC mechanism.
No GPU read, synchronization or file IO occurs inside an observed operation.
Returned tensors and the original call arguments are never changed. Calibrate
this instrumentation before performance use; dispatch is not a GPU busy timer.

interpretation: Both flags are accepted as true in the enabled run. The actual pinned model protocol is false, encoder manager absent and audio modules lack the official compile wrapper in both runs; decoder wrappers are observed as positive controls. This establishes the limitation of this observed native model path, not a failed startup or a universal inability to prepare a different encoder implementation.
